newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim lowers stake in motorway group.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim lowers stake in motorway group.

text.p: Polish industrial and trading conglomerate Elektrim SA sold 120,000 registered preferred shares or 33.3 percent of Autostrada Wielkopolska SA to Kulczyk Holding SA, Elektrim's financial director said on Thursday.
"Elektrim cut its stake to 33.3 percent, which is about what Kulczyk has now," Piotr Mroczkowski told Reuters.
He said the shares were worth about 4.36 million zlotys.

Autostrada Wielkopolski SA, which includes France's Transroute SA and Germany's Strabag Gmbh, is bidding against two other consortia to build the A2 motorway linking central Lodz and the town of Swiecko on the German border.
Mroczkowski said Elektrim and Kulczyk were now the largest shareholders and that the consortium would submit its final offer this month.
Poland plans to build 2,500 kilometres of motorways over the next 15 years.
